'''Spice withdrawal''' was the name given to a collection of symptoms that individuals suffered when overcoming an addiction to [[Spice/Legends|spice]]. [[Anja Gallandro]] suffered from spice withdrawal while trying to overcome her addiction to [[Andris/Legends|andris]]. She was aided by the [[Jedi healer/Legends|Jedi healer]] [[Cilghal]] who used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to remove the spice toxins from her body. While this overcame the physical symptoms, Gallandro still needed to overcome the mental need for spice.
